note: Which model ships for each w5 Starfall Bay kind. i2t = Meshy image to 3D from his Astra pictures (zip sha256 45a9e5e2a87f2fab..., cut by cutpicks.py from this file's "cut"), bought 1 Nov 2026 (step 2, ledger meshy-tasks.json). Step 3, 1 Nov 2026: fitted (dewfit.py with the yaw, roll and tip below), uvclean.py, one atlas, packed into assets/3d/w5, every kind looked at in shot.mjs pairs at 412x915. Kinds under keep stay primitives on purpose. Kinds with a home wear the model shipped in that world: the 1 Nov box has neither the October fitted files nor the raw files, so unatlas.py rebuilt each from its served file and the square of that home's atlas (the biggest of the worlds that ship it; one JPEG generation more than a fresh paint).

keep.dragonflyS: a pale smudge in the game camera: the light blue wings and the thin navy body (a 128 px square) vanish on the dusk sand at a 9 cm ball, where today's blue rod with grey wings reads; Meshy also built the wings as one upright sheet (rolled 90 to lie flat, the body then slants about 15 degrees), so no fit fixes it
keep.kelptangle: Meshy's thin ribbons came back as about 250 crumpled green shards (the popcorn's fault, w1 v34): it reads as crumpled lettuce, today's green coils read as a tangle
keep.oar: the blade came back almost as wide as a third of the length (Astra drew it short and wide, her QA-NOTES picture 17): in the game camera the model reads as a lute or a big spoon, today's thin oar with its blade reads as an oar
keep.tidepool: Meshy built the rock ring and left its middle open, so the sand shows through and only a small teal patch is water: it reads as a ring of stones, today's blue water disc reads as a pool
